result.justification: The evidence includes a stated objective to evaluate MPXV lysis plaque phenotypic variation, and a methodology that outlines several experimental procedures but lacks explicit connections between them.

evidence.quote: In this study, we have evaluated MPXV lysis plaque phenotypic variation through three passages of infection and harvest of selected plaque forming units (PFU)
We conducted a comet-forming assay in order to evaluate viral dissemination of MPXV clones through EEV liberation.
